job.title: Motion Graphics Designer
job.descriptionHtml:
Advanced Systems Group, LLC enables creativity through better technology and operations for media creatives and content owners. From acquisition to delivery, on-premises or in the cloud, ASG ensures our clients’ success through tailored solutions. One of North America’s largest Media and Entertainment Technology and Operations suppliers, we provide engineering services, physical and cloud integration, training, support, and managed services. ASG delivers customized operations and services for all phases of media production, including creative and engineering. Founded in 1997, and providing nationwide services, ASG has teams based in North America, South America, and Europe.

THIS ROLE IS ONLY OPEN TO CANDIDATES IN THE UNITED STATES WITH VALID WORK AUTHORIZATION.

 

Join Our Creative Team at Advanced Systems Group!

Are you passionate about motion design, storytelling, and shaping the way audiences engage with brands on social platforms? At Advanced Systems Group, we’re looking for a dynamic Motion Graphic Designer to bring inventive ideas, artistic flair, and exceptional technical skills to our fast-moving creative production team. If you thrive in high-energy environments and love turning imaginative concepts into visual masterpieces, we want to hear from you!

What You'll Do:

  • Lead end-to-end creation of stunning motion graphics, kinetic typography, and engaging animated videos for major social media campaigns, video platforms, and high-impact corporate content.

  • Collaborate with visionary team leads and stakeholders—translating ambitious ideas into compelling, executable motion content that breaks through the noise.

  • Champion the motion design identity, ensuring every asset you touch is on-brand and visually outstanding.

  • Build and optimize "Essential Graphics" templates in After Effects to empower seamless workflows and creative flexibility for the whole team.

  • Organize design assets with precision to enable effortless collaboration on projects and maintain high standards for every animation.

  • Apply your expertise in illustration, video editing, and deck design to support a wide array of creative initiatives.

  • Tackle urgent creative requests with calm, professionalism, and sharp problem-solving under pressure—your speed and agility keep projects on track.

  • Express your ideas and rationale clearly as you present designs, pitch concepts, and explain creative solutions to cross-functional teams.

  • Manage multiple fast-paced projects at once, keeping high-quality output flowing under tight, ever-changing deadlines.

  • Stay on the cutting edge by researching industry trends, new technologies, and evolving social media formats—ensuring our content leads the market.

Why Join Us?

  • Be at the forefront of motion graphics for industry-leading brands

  • Collaborate with a vibrant, multidisciplinary team that values creativity and outside-the-box ideas

  • Access cutting-edge creative tools—including the latest generative AI models

  • Drive real impact and see your work showcased in major campaigns

  • Enjoy opportunities to develop new skills, pursue your passion for design, and grow your career in a supportive, innovation-focused environment

What We’re Looking For:

  • Meticulous attention to detail and capacity to juggle multiple projects and urgent deadlines

  • Adaptability and creative agility in a rapidly evolving media landscape

  • Organizational superpowers and the ability to deliver high-quality results in a high-volume, deadline-driven setting

  • Brilliant storytelling instincts—able to distill technical or data-heavy concepts into simple, captivating motion stories

  • Strong command of animation fundamentals (timing, pacing, easing, anticipation)

Requirements:

  • BA/BS degree in Design, CS, or relevant experience

  • 6+ years of hands-on social content design—ideally in an agency, brand, or newsroom environment

  • Advanced skills in Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, and familiarity with Premiere, Photoshop, Cinema 4D

  • Experience leveraging Google generative AI models (Nano Banana, Veo, Flow) to push creative boundaries

  • In-depth understanding of each major social/video platform (LinkedIn, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube) and what makes content shine there

  • Rigorous grasp of design fundamentals and current trends

  • Working knowledge of the Google App Suite

Bonus Points:

  • Proven experience collaborating on cross-team projects

  • Strong skills in Adobe Creative Suite for developing static designs and templates

  • Familiarity with B2B and digital marketing creative best practices

If you’re ready to deliver next-level motion graphics that engage, inspire, and leave a lasting mark, let’s create something incredible together. Apply today—your talent belongs here!

Advanced Systems Group LLC provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
